title: Nitrox
body: Nitrox leaks from azoite. Nitrox Permease, in the membrane, fills an intracellular pool when the plume is above a faint trace. The pool sits on the resource bar like the other fuels.

Nitroxidex Reductase is what spends it. The enzyme needs Nitrox and Oxidex together, in the cytosol, and recharges three Refluxin into Fluxin for each pair. ATP synthase spends that Fluxin. A cell can import Nitrox and still gain nothing from it until that reductase and ATP synthase are both expressed.
